rows.name: joint_selected

provenance.adversarial_semantics: Every update: prior and encoded-state fake paths averaged; labeled complete and all-record action-hidden joint views averaged; mask fixed context and structural input mask; no synthetic cycle
provenance.normalization: Shared state scaler fit all available training states/successors; action scaler fit labeled actions only
provenance.initialization: All E/G1/G2/G3/prior parameters freshly initialized; no pretrained model weights
provenance.loss_reductions: action: mean squared standardized error over labeled batch x 2; each state: mean squared standardized error over batch x 6 + mean BCE logits over batch x 2; sum three weighted heads + default MoG prior regularizer once + adversarial_weight*(joint + marginal_weight*mean three marginals); D=sumroles; each role averages its views and fake paths

training.control_input: Current observed state plus terrain; no current/previous action or successor input
training.initialization: All E/G1/G2/G3/prior parameters freshly initialized; no pretrained model weights
